title: AWS Lambda to AWS Cloudtrail data events pattern using AWS SAM
description: This pattern demonstrates using AWS CloudTrail and AWS Lambda data events for monitoring invocations via Slack notifications

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern demonstrates how customers can monitor manual invocations of their sensitive AWS Lambda functions using Slack with the help of AWS CloudTrail and Amazon CloudWatch subscription filters.
